title: Resolved selection segments (segments/segments.json)
description: Canonical, hashed resolution of a project's `selection` into ordered source-time segments. Absent/null selection resolves to a single whole-video segment [0, source_duration_ms].

whole_video.description: true when selection was null/absent: a single implicit segment covering the entire source. Drives the mux fast path (-c:v copy).

join_clips.description: true => concatenate segments (in list order) into one deliverable; false => one deliverable per segment. Irrelevant when whole_video is true.

snap_edges.description: Resolved project default for edge snapping (per-segment `exact` overrides this).

snap_search_window_ms.description: Max distance (ms) a window edge was allowed to move to reach a snap candidate.

source_duration_ms.description: Full source duration in ms (from source/metadata.json).

index.description: Position in the resolved list; drives output order and per-segment paths.

id.description: Human-stable id (from selection or auto-assigned, e.g. seg0).

start_ms.description: Resolved (post-snap) start on the absolute source timeline.

end_ms.description: Resolved (post-snap) end on the absolute source timeline.

snapped.description: true if either edge moved from the requested value during resolution.

exact.description: Effective exact-cut flag applied to this segment (per-window exact OR global !snap_edges).

adjustments.description: Human-facing notes about how each edge resolved (snapped, left-as-requested, refused).

has_speech.description: Whether any full-transcript cue overlaps this window; null when unknown (no transcript consulted).

clip_wav.description: Project-relative path to the extracted clip WAV (set by `segments cut`).

clip_video.description: Project-relative path to the extracted clip video (set by `segments cut`; null on the whole-video fast path).

selection_hash.description: Stable hash over the canonical resolved segment list; threaded into downstream artifact provenance so a changed selection invalidates bound approvals.

notes.description: Informational resolution notes (overlaps, out-of-order re-sequencing, empty-speech windows).
